skill.description: Prepare AI skills for public marketplaces by auditing content, packaging public artifacts, publishing GitHub repositories, and submitting supported marketplace requests.

skill.author: Sliense-ysd

security_audit.summary: Most secret-pattern and Markdown static hits are false positives from scanner signatures or formatting. Real risks remain in outbound marketplace submissions, public GitHub publishing commands, relative helper script execution, and audit output that can reveal matched secret lines.

remediation.suggestion: Redact matched values before storing or printing findings. Show kind, file, line, and a masked value or hash instead.
Replace parent-directory helper paths with bundled scripts, installed commands, or preflight checks that resolve trusted locations.
Add a dry run and explicit confirmation before copying files, staging changes, or pushing a public repository.
Document the fields sent to each endpoint and require confirmation before posting to Skillstore or SkillMap.

content.value_statement: Publishing a local AI skill can expose private files or miss marketplace requirements. This skill guides safety checks, packaging, GitHub publication, and submission.
actual_capabilities: Runs a public-safety audit script for likely secrets, local paths, and private references.
Guides public package creation with the local skill-package workflow.
Checks required marketplace metadata, supporting files, agent config, and license guidance.
Documents GitHub publication steps for clean public repositories and skill subdirectory URLs.
Submits repository URLs to Skillstore and sends SkillMap feedback listing requests.
Records submission IDs, status URLs, and manual follow-up items.
limitations: SkillMap self-serve publishing is not verified; the workflow uses feedback or contact routes.
Relative helper script paths depend on a specific local repository layout.
The skill does not guarantee marketplace acceptance or review timelines.
Users must verify that packaged artifacts contain no private files before public upload.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Open-Source Skill Release
use_cases.description: Audit a local skill, package a public artifact, and prepare a clean repository for review.

use_cases.title: Submit a Team Skill to Skillstore
use_cases.description: Send a verified public repository URL to Skillstore and record the returned submission details.

use_cases.title: Request a SkillMap Listing
use_cases.description: Create a concise listing request with repository details, safety notes, and contact information.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Skill Before Publishing
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review the skill at [path] for public marketplace readiness. Report blocking issues before packaging.

prompt_templates.title: Package a Public Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a public package for the skill at [path]. Use public mode when the source folder is not portable.

prompt_templates.title: Submit a Prepared Repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Publish the prepared skill repository to Skillstore and create a SkillMap listing request. Use [repo URL] and concise notes.

prompt_templates.title: Run an End-to-End Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [path], package it, prepare a clean GitHub repository, submit to supported marketplaces, and write a final submission record.

output_examples.input: Audit my local support-agent skill before marketplace submission.
output_examples.output: The report lists one blocking secret reference, two portability warnings, and recommends building a public package before publishing.

output_examples.input: Submit this public repo to Skillstore and record the result.
output_examples.output: The result includes the marketplace response summary, submission status link, and follow-up notes for the user.

output_examples.input: Prepare a SkillMap listing request for my packaged skill.
output_examples.output: A concise request message is prepared with the repository URL, skill summary, contact email, and safety statement.

best_practices: Run the public audit before any packaging or upload step.
Publish a clean package instead of a source folder with local dependencies.
Record marketplace responses, timestamps, submission IDs, and follow-up needs.
anti_patterns: Publishing a skill before checking for secrets, private paths, or owner-only assumptions.
Using unverified marketplace routes as if they are officially supported.
Running the publish workflow from a directory that contains unrelated private files.

faq.question: Does this skill publish directly to every marketplace?
faq.answer: No. It supports verified routes and tells users when a marketplace route is unverified.

faq.question: Which marketplaces are covered?
faq.answer: The workflow covers Skillstore submission and SkillMap listing requests through public feedback or contact channels.

faq.question: Does it replace security review?
faq.answer: No. It provides a public-safety audit and workflow checks, but humans must review sensitive releases.

faq.question: Can it handle skills inside larger repositories?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use public subdirectory URLs when a marketplace accepts them.

faq.question: What information is sent to marketplaces?
faq.answer: The scripts send public repository URLs, optional notes, optional contact email, and listing request text.

faq.question: What should I verify before submission?
faq.answer: Verify that the package has no secrets, private paths, broken links, or owner-only runtime assumptions.
